'''Mioara Mugur-Schächter''' ({{née|Iscovici}},<ref name=":2">{{Cite book |last=Jammer |first=Max |url=https://www.google.fr/books/edition/The_Philosophy_of_Quantum_Mechanics/X6fvAAAAMAAJ?hl=en |title=The Philosophy of Quantum Mechanics: The Interpretations of Quantum Mechanics in Historical Perspective |date=1974-12-03 |publisher=Wiley |isbn=978-0-471-43958-5 |language=en}}</ref> born 1929<ref>{{Cite book |last=Healthcare |first=Informa |url=https://www.google.fr/books/edition/Who_s_who_in_Science_in_Europe/r-IrAQAAMAAJ?hl=fr&gbpv=1&bsq=mioara+mugur-sch%C3%A4chter+1929&dq=mioara+mugur-sch%C3%A4chter+1929&printsec=frontcover |title=Who's who in Science in Europe: A Biographical Guide in Science, Technology, Agriculture, and Medicine |date=1989 |publisher=Longman |isbn=978-0-582-04717-4 |language=en}}</ref>) is a French-Romanian physicist specialized in the foundations of quantum mechanics, probability theory, and theory of communication of information.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Mioara Mugur-Schächter |url=https://savoirs.ens.fr/conferencier.php?id=211 |access-date=2024-11-18 |website=Savoir ENS |language=fr}}</ref> She is also an epistemologist.<ref name=":0" /> As a professor at the [[University of Reims Champagne-Ardenne|University of Reims]], she founded there the Laboratoire de Mécanique Quantique et Structures de l'Information, which she directed until 1997.<ref name=":0" />

== Education ==
After completing her undergraduate studies in physics and becoming part of the first nuclear physics group in the [[Socialist Republic of Romania]], she traveled to France in 1962 to begin her PhD at the [[University of Paris|Sorbonne]] under [[Louis de Broglie]].<ref name=":1">Bio in {{Cite book |chapter-url=http://www.worldscientific.com/doi/abs/10.1142/9781783266449_0019 |chapter=Mioara Mugur-Schachter: Information, Quantum Mechanics and Probabilities |date=2015 |publisher=IMPERIAL COLLEGE PRESS |isbn=978-1-78326-643-2 |volume=09 |pages=311–326 |language=en |doi=10.1142/9781783266449_0019 |title=The Human Face of Computing |series=Advances in Computer Science and Engineering: Texts }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Louis de Broglie - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=105807&fChrono=1 |access-date=2025-06-04 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> In her PhD thesis "Étude du caractère complet de la théorie quantique", she worked a formal argument to invalidate [[John von Neumann]]'s [[Von Neumann's no hidden variables proof|no hidden variables proof]], published in 1964,<ref>Mugur-Schächter, M. (1964). ''Étude du caractère complet de la théorie quantique'' Paris: Gauthier-Villars.</ref><ref name=":2" /> two years before [[John Stewart Bell|John Bell]]'s famous invalidation paper.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Bell |first=J. S. |title=On the problem of hidden variables in quantum mechanics |journal=Reviews of Modern Physics |volume=38 |number=3 |pages=447 |year=1966}}</ref><ref name=":1" /> Her invalidation argument was later cited by various authors including Bell himself.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Bell |first=J. S. |title=On the impossible pilot wave |journal=Foundations of Physics |volume=12 |pages=989–999 |year=1976|url=https://cds.cern.ch/record/138187/files/198207191.pdf}}</ref><ref>{{cite thesis|last=Abbott|first= A. A. |year=2015 |title= Value indefiniteness, randomness and unpredictability in quantum foundations (Doctoral dissertation, Ecole normale supérieure-ENS)|page=14|url=https://theses.hal.science/tel-01761911/file/Abbott-2015-These.pdf}}</ref> Her refutation was inspired by previous work by [[Paulette Destouches-Février]] on von Neumann's proof.<ref name=":2" /> 

== Work ==
{{Primary sources|section|date=September 2025}}
In the 1980s her work on relativized conceptualization of quantum mechanics sought a unified mathematical description combining probabilistic and informational approaches.<ref name=Carvallo-1992/>{{rp|378}} Her work included challenges to the [[Copenhagen interpretation]] of quantum mechanics as insufficiently defining its concept of probability. Her approach to these problems formalized the [[propensity]] approach to probability of [[Karl Popper]].<ref name=Carvallo-1992>{{Cite book |url=https://link.springer.com/10.1007/978-94-011-2779-0 |title=Nature, Cognition and System II: Current Systems-Scientific Research on Natural and Cognitive Systems Volume 2: On Complementarity and Beyond |date=1992 |publisher=Springer Netherlands |isbn=978-94-010-5234-4 |editor-last=Carvallo |editor-first=Marc E. |location=Dordrecht |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-94-011-2779-0}}</ref>{{rp|x}}

In the 1990s she organized a working group (''Centre d'études pour la synthèse d'une épistémologie formelle'')
in French epistemological circles and edited a book collecting epistemologic studies<ref name=QMMCA>{{cite book |title=Quantum Mechanics, Mathematics, Cognition and Action: Proposals for a Formalized Epistemology |editor1-last=Mugur-Schächter |editor1-first=Mioara |editor2-last=Van der Merwe |editor2-first=Alwyn |publisher=Springer Netherlands |location=Dordrecht |year=2003 |doi=10.1007/0-306-48144-8 |isbn=978-1-4020-1120-7 |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/0-306-48144-8}}</ref> including contributions from notable figures such as {{Ill|Michel Paty|fr}},<ref name=QMMCA/>{{rp|37}} [[Jean Petitot]],<ref name=QMMCA/>{{rp|73}} [[Michel Bitbol]],<ref name=QMMCA/>{{rp|389}} [[Giuseppe Longo]],<ref name=QMMCA/>{{rp|21}} and others.

Mugur-Schächter's work was listed in a 1992 "Bibliography on quantum logics and related structures".<ref>{{cite journal |last=Pavičić |first=M. |year=1992 |title=Bibliography on quantum logics and related structures. |journal=International Journal of Theoretical Physics |volume=31 |issue=3 |pages=373–455 |url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF00739999 |doi=10.1007/BF00739999 |bibcode=1992IJTP...31..373P|url-access=subscription }}</ref> Her work has been described as a form of ''relativistic quantum logic'', a way of combining the concepts of [[Hilbert space]] and [[Lorentzian manifold|Lorentzian spacetime]] to create a quantum logic subject to special relativity but with explicit concepts of signaling.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Svetlichny |first=George |date=November 2000 |title=The Space-Time Origin of Quantum Mechanics: Covering Law |url=https://link.springer.com/10.1023/A:1003797204134 |journal=Foundations of Physics |language=en |volume=30 |issue=11 |pages=1819–1847 |doi=10.1023/A:1003797204134 |issn=0015-9018|url-access=subscription |arxiv=quant-ph/9912099 }}</ref>{{rp|1820}}

In 2011, Mugur-Schächter organized a debate on the concepts of randomness, statistics and probability with [[Maria Luisa Dalla Chiara]], [[Cristian Calude]], Giuseppe Longo and [[Cristian Calude]],<ref>{{cite AV media | people = Cristian Calude, Maria Dalla Chiara, Giuseppe Longo, Karl Svozil, Mugur-Schächter, Mioara (speakers) | year = 2011 | title = Developments of the Concepts of Randomness, Statistic and Probability | medium = Debate video | publisher = École Normale Supérieure | location = Paris | url = https://savoirs.ens.fr/expose.php?id=508 | access-date = }}</ref> that was published as part of a special issue of [[Mathematical Structures in Computer Science]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Longo |first1=Giuseppe |last2=Mugur-SchäChter |first2=Mioara |last3=Other Contributors to this special issue |date=June 2014 |title=Debate on the concept of probability, and conclusions to this special issue on developments of the concepts of randomness, statistics and probability |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/product/identifier/S0960129512000746/type/journal_article |journal=Mathematical Structures in Computer Science |language=en |volume=24 |issue=3 |article-number=e240310 |doi=10.1017/S0960129512000746 |issn=0960-1295|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
